mapper.select: SELECT mission_id AS id , mission_id AS mission_id , title , description , mission_type , trigger_event , target_count , reward_point , place_keyword , max_total_cost , start_at , end_at , created_at FROM `MISSION` ORDER BY mission_id DESC

SELECT mission_id AS id , mission_id AS mission_id , title , description , mission_type , trigger_event , target_count , reward_point , place_keyword , max_total_cost , start_at , end_at , created_at FROM `MISSION` WHERE mission_id = #{missionId}

SELECT id AS user_mission_id , user_id , mission_id , current_count , progress , status , reward_received , completed_at , created_at , updated_at FROM `MISSION_PROGRESS` WHERE user_id = #{userId} AND mission_id = #{missionId}
SELECT mission_id AS missionId , status AS status FROM `MISSION_PROGRESS` WHERE user_id = #{userId}
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM `MISSION` WHERE (start_at IS NULL OR start_at <= NOW()) AND (end_at IS NULL OR end_at >= NOW())
SELECT DATE(created_at) AS day , COALESCE(SUM(point), 0) AS cnt FROM `POINT_HISTORY` WHERE created_at >= DATE_SUB(CURDATE(), INTERVAL 13 DAY) GROUP BY DATE(created_at) ORDER BY day ASC
mapper.update: UPDATE `MISSION_PROGRESS` SET reward_received = TRUE , completed_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(6) , updated_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(6) WHERE id = #{userMissionId}

UPDATE `MISSION`
title = #{title},
description = #{description},
mission_type = #{missionType},
trigger_event = #{triggerEvent},
target_count = #{targetCount},
reward_point = #{rewardPoint},
place_keyword = #{placeKeyword},
max_total_cost = #{maxTotalCost},
start_at = #{startAt},
end_at = #{endAt},
WHERE mission_id = #{id}
